claims.sentence: An update in 2025, covering 46 studies and some 32,000 quotations, put the rate at 16.9\%, with no improvement over time \citep{baethge2025quotation}.
claims.claim: 2025 update of the meta-analysis: 46 studies, ~32,000 quotations, 16.9% quotation error rate, no improvement over time.
